fit: 前者研究认知、社会与行为；后者侧重正向心理、韧性与行为改变。属于研究生层次的持续教育路径。
The first explores cognition, social processes and behavior; the second focuses on well-being, resilience and behavior change. These are graduate-level continuing education paths.
age: 研究生学分注册要求18+，通常需本科学位。13岁不适用。
Graduate-credit enrollment requires age 18+ and ordinarily a bachelor’s degree. Not applicable at 13.
time: 各4门在线课程、16研究生学分；可约8个月完成，最迟3年内完成。
Each requires four online courses/16 graduate credits; completion can take about eight months, with a three-year limit.
price: 每个完整证书按当前学费合计$14,320。
Current total tuition: $14,320 per complete certificate.
credential: Harvard Extension School Graduate Certificate；每门需B或以上。与一门 HarvardX 结业证书不同。
Harvard Extension School Graduate Certificate; B or higher in every course. Distinct from a single HarvardX course certificate.
requirements: 人类行为：基础课＋3选修，PSYC E-15可作准备但不计入。积极心理学：1门正念／韧性＋1门行为改变＋2选修。

Human Behavior: a foundation plus three electives; PSYC E-15 may prepare students but does not count. Positive Psychology: one mindfulness/resilience course, one behavior-change course and two electives.
links: 积极心理学与幸福感证书

title: 高中暑期项目
Pre-College / Secondary School Program
fit: 未来可查看心理学暑期课程。Pre-College 与 Secondary School Program 的学分及教学形式不同，须按具体项目选课。
Future psychology summer options. Pre-College and the Secondary School Program have different credit and delivery formats; choose by the specific offering.
age: 2026规则：6月20日前满16岁，7月31日前不能满19岁；Pre-College毕业年份为2027／2028，SSP为2026–2028。13岁不符合。
2026 rules: age 16 by June 20 and not 19 before July 31. Pre-College graduation years: 2027/2028; SSP: 2026–2028. Not eligible at 13.
time: 2026暑期已结束；2027资格、课程、上课时间尚未核实公布。
Summer 2026 has ended; 2027 eligibility, courses and timetables are not yet verified as published.
price: 2026申请费$75；未来学费与在线选项按新学年课程确认。
2026 application fee: $75; confirm future tuition and online offerings for the new cycle.
credential: Pre-College为非学分；SSP有大学学分路线。具体记录与结业要求需按项目核对。
Pre-College is noncredit; SSP offers college-credit study. Verify each program’s completion record and requirements.
requirements: 需学业记录、辅导员材料与监护人参与；非英语母语者可能需英语证明。
Academic records, counselor materials and parent/guardian involvement; English evidence may be required for nonnative speakers.

title: 在线心理学学分课程
Online psychology courses for credit
tag: 15+且完成十年级 · 未来参考
fit: 目录列有 PSYCH 1101心理学导论、2800社会心理学导论、2750人格导论、1102认知科学导论，各3学分。社会心理学与 Amy 兴趣尤其相关。
The catalog includes PSYCH 1101 Introduction to Psychology, 2800 Social Psychology, 2750 Personality and 1102 Cognitive Science, each three credits. Social psychology is especially relevant.
age: 在线暑期／冬季须15–19岁，并已完成十年级；校方明确不接受例外。因此13岁不能报名。
Online summer/winter students must be 15–19 and have completed grade 10. Cornell explicitly allows no exceptions; age 13 is ineligible.
time: 在线学期、同步或异步与作业量取决于当期具体班级。目录存在不代表下一期一定开课；2027课表待确认。
Session, synchronous/asynchronous format and workload depend on the specific section. A catalog listing does not guarantee the next offering; 2027 schedules need confirmation.
price: 官方公开价适用2025秋–2026夏：$1,940/学分，3学分$5,820，另$75申请费及可能的材料费。不是2027报价。
Published Fall 2025–Summer 2026 tuition: $1,940/credit, or $5,820 for three credits, plus a $75 application fee and possible materials. Not a 2027 quote.
credential: 正式 Cornell 学分与成绩单；这条路线的主要成果不是 MOOC 结业证书。
Official Cornell academic credit and transcript; this route’s main outcome is academic study recorded on a transcript.
requirements: 需申请、证明大学课程准备程度、满足先修及英语要求。费用和注册按未来具体学期核对。
Application, college readiness, prerequisites and strong English are required. Recheck fees and registration for the future session.

title: 领导力心理学证书
Psychology of Leadership Certificate
fit: Allan Filipowicz 的课程研究行为驱动力、管理情绪、理解他人、影响力与团队。题材契合，但设计给专业人士。
Allan Filipowicz covers motivation, emotion management, interpreting behavior, influence and teams. Relevant subject matter, designed for professionals.
age: eCornell 官方 FAQ 明确：证书项目必须18岁以上。13岁不符合。
eCornell’s FAQ explicitly requires age 18+ for certificate programs. Not eligible at 13.
time: 6门课程，约3个月，每周4–6小时；在线小组、作业反馈。核查时列9月9日、9月23日等开课选择。
Six courses over approximately three months, 4–6 hours/week; online cohorts with assignment feedback. Listed starts include September 9 and 23.
credential: Cornell University 非学分专业证书；不是大学学位或学分成绩单。
A Cornell University noncredit professional certificate, not a degree or academic-credit transcript.
requirements: 通常无正式申请或先修要求，但须符合18+年龄条件；按课程进度完成项目与测评。
Most programs require no formal application or prerequisites, but the 18+ rule applies. Complete projects and assessments on the course schedule.

title: 心理学导论 · PSYC 110 公开录像
Introduction to Psychology · PSYC 110 recordings
fit: Paul Bloom 的完整大学课堂录像，可帮助 Amy 先判断是否喜欢心理学。与 Coursera 的证书课程是不同访问路线。
Paul Bloom’s university lecture recordings can help Amy explore her interest. This is a separate access route from the Coursera certificate course.
age: 公开资源，无大学入学或申请过程；并非青少年专门课程。
Public resources without a university application or admission process; not specifically designed for teens.
time: 2007年春季录制，随时观看，无直播或截止时间。内容较早，适合与较新材料对照。
Recorded in Spring 2007; watch anytime without live meetings or deadlines. Use alongside more recent material.
price: 免费，无需课程账户。
Free; no course account required.
credential: 无证书、无大学学分。
No certificate or academic credit.
requirements: 自行观看、阅读与做笔记，没有官方批改或评分。
Independent viewing, reading and notes; no official marking or grading.

title: 人类行为生物学 · 公开讲座
Human Behavioral Biology · Open lectures
fit: Robert Sapolsky 从生物学角度解释行为。适合想继续追问大脑、激素和环境影响的 Amy，阅读和科学背景要求较高。
Robert Sapolsky approaches behavior through biology. Useful if Amy wants to explore brain, hormonal and environmental influences; a more demanding scientific extension.
age: 公开大学讲座，不是13岁招生项目。观看须遵循视频平台适用规则。
Public university lectures, not an enrollment program for 13-year-olds. Video-platform rules apply.
time: 链接为2010年3月29日的导论录像，2011年由 Stanford 官方频道发布；自选片段、随时观看。
The linked introduction was recorded March 29, 2010 and published by Stanford’s official channel in 2011. Watch selected material at your own pace.
price: 公开视频免费。
Free public video.
credential: 观看公开视频没有课程证书或 Stanford 学分。
Watching the public recordings earns no course certificate or Stanford credit.
requirements: 建议先学基础心理学，再按兴趣补充；这里不把公开视频当成可注册的现行大学课程。
Suggested after introductory psychology, as enrichment. The recordings are not presented as a currently enrollable university class.
links: Stanford 对行为研究的介绍
Stanford on the study of behavior

fit: James Engell 以经典演讲分析、意见文章和短演讲练习教授论证与修辞；符合 Amy 对说服的兴趣。
James Engell uses speech analysis, opinion writing and short-speech exercises to teach argument and rhetoric; relevant to Amy’s interest in persuasion.

title: 逻辑导论
Introduction to Logic
fit: Michael Genesereth 的计算视角逻辑导论，覆盖命题、关系与函数逻辑。斯坦福官方指出可用于中学生；情绪与行为心理并非重点。

Michael Genesereth introduces propositional, relational and functional logic from a computational perspective. Stanford describes it as suitable for secondary-school learners; emotion and behavioral psychology are not the focus.
